# BillQyro

> Smart billing and premium invoicing platform for small businesses, freelancers, and service shops.

BillQyro is a free, offline-first SaaS billing app for small shops, studios, clinics, tailors, repair businesses, and educators in India and Bangladesh. It supports English and Bengali (Bangla).

## Key Features
- PDF invoice generation (A4/A5 templates)
- Customer ledger with balance tracking
- UPI QR code payment collection
- Product and inventory management
- Expense tracking and profit/loss reports
- WhatsApp payment reminders
- Offline-first — works without internet
- Multi-workspace support
- Live invoice sharing links
- Voice billing in Bengali

## Pricing
- Starter: Free (50 invoices, 25 customers)
- Pro: 499 INR per month (500 invoices, 200 customers, premium themes)
- Lifetime: 14,999 INR one-time (unlimited everything)
